criteria.criterion: Every registered core command runtime (its `_dispatch_*` handler) calls its S2a parser factory via a `parser_factory` reference wired onto its core `Route` in `_registry.py`; no parallel imperative grammar remains for that command. `metrics` is excluded (already migrated in S2c).

Accepted/rejected argv matrices cover missing/surplus values, space/equal options, `--`, global confirmation/output extraction, per-family unknown-token semantics (skip vs reject-exit-2), and representative malformed input.
Existing persisted effects, no-effect refusals, diagnostics, streams, and exit codes show no unapproved behavior delta, verified through real production-path (subprocess/interface) tests.

Parser construction imports no domain executor or optional dependency, and a real selected execution resolves no unrelated parser factory or handler (proven by a construction-exclusion probe plus a dispatch-isolation assertion).

All touched modules meet module-size/complexity policy, and each family is proven revertable as one unit (parser factory + `Route` wiring + handler switch) — demonstrated by confirming the family's parser module, its single `_registry.py` wiring line, and its `_dispatch_*` switch form one self-contained hunk with no cross-family coupling.
